Neuroimaging in Python: Pipelines and Interfaces

Nipype, an open-source, community-developed initiative under the umbrella of NiPy, is a Python project that
provides a uniform interface to existing neuroimaging software and facilitates interaction between these
packages within a single workflow. Nipype provides an environment that encourages interactive exploration of
algorithms from different packages (e.g., SPM, FSL, FreeSurfer, AFNI, Slicer, ANTS), eases the design of
workflows within and between packages, and reduces the learning curve necessary to use different packages.

value.name: Trigger Nipype tutorial Github Action
value.run:
set -x
curl -X POST \
-H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.TUTORIAL_ACCESS_TOKEN }}" \
-H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
https://api.github.com/repos/miykael/nipype_tutorial/actions/workflows/testing.yml/dispatches \
-d '{"ref": "master", "inputs": {"nipype_branch": "'${BRANCH_NAME}'"}}'
sleep 10

value.name: Check Action was successfully dispatched
value.run:
START=${{ steps.start.outputs.start_time }}
RUN_ID=$(curl -s -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
  'https://api.github.com/repos/miykael/nipype_tutorial/actions/runs?created=>'${START}'&per_page=1' \
  | jq -r '.workflow_runs[0].id')

# fail if not extracted
[[ -n $RUN_ID ]] || exit 1
echo run_id=$RUN_ID >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

value.name: Check if action completed
value.run:
RUN_ID=${{ steps.dispatched.outputs.run_id }}
while :
do
  TIMESTAMP=$(date +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')
  # check status every 5 minutes
  STATUS=$(curl -s -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
  https://api.github.com/repos/miykael/nipype_tutorial/actions/runs/${RUN_ID} \
  | jq -r '.conclusion')
  case $STATUS in
  success)
    echo "[$TIMESTAMP] Tutorial run $RUN_ID completed successfully."
    exit 0
    ;;
  failure)
    echo "[$TIMESTAMP] Tutorial run $RUN_ID failed."
    exit 1
    ;;
  *)
    echo "[$TIMESTAMP] Conclusion ($STATUS) is not yet complete"
    sleep 300
  esac
done

value.name: Cancel ongoing run if cancelled or failed
value.run:
set -x
RUN_ID=${{ steps.dispatched.outputs.run_id }}
echo "Something went wrong, cancelling dispatched run"
curl -s -X POST \
  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.TUTORIAL_ACCESS_TOKEN }}" \
  https://api.github.com/repos/miykael/nipype_tutorial/actions/runs/${RUN_ID}/cancel

use_relative_paths = false

value.name: Angle rep
value.description: 'quaternion' or 'euler'. Representation of rotation angles.

value.name: Apply isoxfm
value.description: A float. As applyxfm but forces isotropic resampling.

value.name: Apply xfm
value.description: A boolean. Apply transformation supplied by in_matrix_file or uses_qform to use the affine matrix stored in the reference header.

value.name: Bbrslope
value.description: A float. Value of bbr slope.

value.name: Bbrtype
value.description: 'signed' or 'global_abs' or 'local_abs'. Type of bbr cost function: signed [default], global_abs, local_abs.

value.name: Bgvalue
value.description: A float. Use specified background value for points outside fov.

value.name: Bins
value.description: An integer (int or long). Number of histogram bins.

value.name: Coarse search
value.description: An integer (int or long). Coarse search delta angle.

value.name: Cost
value.description: 'mutualinfo' or 'corratio' or 'normcorr' or 'normmi' or 'leastsq' or 'labeldiff' or 'bbr'. Cost function.

value.name: Cost func
value.description: 'mutualinfo' or 'corratio' or 'normcorr' or 'normmi' or 'leastsq' or 'labeldiff' or 'bbr'. Cost function.

value.name: Datatype
value.description: 'char' or 'short' or 'int' or 'float' or 'double'. Force output data type.

value.name: Display init
value.description: A boolean. Display initial matrix.

value.name: Dof
value.description: An integer (int or long). Number of transform degrees of freedom.

value.name: Echospacing
value.description: A float. Value of epi echo spacing - units of seconds.

value.name: Fieldmap
value.description: A file name. Fieldmap image in rads/s - must be already registered to the reference image.

value.name: Fieldmapmask
value.description: A file name. Mask for fieldmap image.

value.name: Fine search
value.description: An integer (int or long). Fine search delta angle.

value.name: Force scaling
value.description: A boolean. Force rescaling even for low-res images.

value.name: In file
value.description: An existing file name. Input file.

value.name: In matrix file
value.description: A file name. Input 4x4 affine matrix.

value.name: In weight
value.description: An existing file name. File for input weighting volume.

value.name: Interp
value.description: 'trilinear' or 'nearestneighbour' or 'sinc' or 'spline'. Final interpolation method used in reslicing.

value.name: Min sampling
value.description: A float. Set minimum voxel dimension for sampling.

value.name: No clamp
value.description: A boolean. Do not use intensity clamping.

value.name: No resample
value.description: A boolean. Do not change input sampling.

value.name: No resample blur
value.description: A boolean. Do not use blurring on downsampling.

value.name: No search
value.description: A boolean. Set all angular searches to ranges 0 to 0.

value.name: Padding size
value.description: An integer (int or long). For applyxfm: interpolates outside image by size.

value.name: Pedir
value.description: An integer (int or long). Phase encode direction of epi - 1/2/3=x/y/z & -1/-2/-3=-x/-y/-z.

value.name: Ref weight
value.description: An existing file name. File for reference weighting volume.

value.name: Reference
value.description: An existing file name. Reference file.

value.name: Rigid2d
value.description: A boolean. Use 2d rigid body mode - ignores dof.

value.name: Save log
value.description: A boolean. Save to log file.

value.name: Schedule
value.description: An existing file name. Replaces default schedule.

value.name: Searchr x
value.description: A list of from 2 to 2 items which are an integer (int or long). Search angles along x-axis, in degrees.

value.name: Searchr y
value.description: A list of from 2 to 2 items which are an integer (int or long). Search angles along y-axis, in degrees.

value.name: Searchr z
value.description: A list of from 2 to 2 items which are an integer (int or long). Search angles along z-axis, in degrees.
